headline: Spain raises minimum wage in 2027. The announcement comes just two weeks before the elections
summary: The Spanish government will raise the minimum wage next year, Labour Minister Yolanda Diaz announced on Monday. It is the ninth increase by the socialist-led executive since 2018, announced two weeks before elections.
why: The minimum wage sets a legal wage floor that affects labour costs for employers across Spain's economy, particularly retail, hospitality and services.
